subject: AACC Weekly | Asma Khan on campus, Bollywood night, Roshni
text:
ASIAN AMERICAN CULTURAL CENTER | WEEKLY NEWSLETTER

Chef Asma Khan is on campus Oct 28 - Nov 6 as the Fall 2026 Yale Global Table Fellow.

* Monsoon Table: Water and Cuisine with Chef Asma Khan (South Asian Studies Council). Mon Nov 2, 5:00pm, Luce Hall 101. Registration required; reception follows.
* Dinner & Dialogue with Dr. Asma Khan. Wed Nov 4, 5-6:30pm at the AACC. Catered by Sanctuary Kitchen. Pre-registration required.
* Unmasking Bollywood Stereotypes: movie + discussion with Prof. Rohit De (AACC PAE). Thu Nov 5, 6-8pm, AACC MPR.
* Yale Navarasa at Roshni 2026, Fri Nov 6.

AACC, 295 Crown St
